description: pixel art, top-down view straight from above of a dark spruce forest floor at night: thick moss, fallen spruce needles, small ferns and twisting roots, muted very dark palette of deep green, brown and blue-grey, a faint pale strip of trampled ground across the middle dividing two halves, slightly darker edges, soft even dusk light, flat ground seen from above for a dim background behind game cards, very low contrast, no standing trees, no people, no animals, no weapons, no text, no border
